en.headline: Trading card show draws collectors to AsiaWorld-Expo through Sunday
en.dek: The two-day Hong Kong Trading Card Show continues at AsiaWorld-Expo with more than 300 exhibitors offering rare Pokémon, sports and One Piece cards, live box breaks and on-site grading.
body: Collectors continue to fill AsiaWorld-Expo on Sunday for the second day of the Hong Kong Trading Card Show, the largest edition of the event held so far with more than 300 exhibitors from Hong Kong and across Asia.

The organisers said the show features rare and modern trading cards including Pokémon, sports rookies, One Piece and Yu-Gi-Oh titles, along with live box-breaking sessions and lucky draws. Official on-site card grading services are available for the first time at a Hong Kong trading-card convention.

General admission runs from 1pm to 8pm, with limited VIP tickets allowing entry from noon. The venue is at AsiaWorld-Summit (Hall 2) and is reachable by MTR to AsiaWorld-Expo station. The organisers advised visitors to buy tickets in advance as places have been in demand.

zh.headline: 香港交易卡展覽亞博續舉行 逾300攤位至周日
zh.dek: 為期兩日的香港交易卡展覽周日繼續在亞洲國際博覽館舉行，超過300個攤位展出寶可夢、運動卡及海賊王等收藏卡，並設現場開箱及評級服務。
body: 香港交易卡展覽周日進入第二天，繼續在亞洲國際博覽館舉行。主辦單位表示，今屆規模為歷來最大，匯聚超過300個來自香港及亞洲各地的展商。
展覽展出稀有及現代交易卡，包括寶可夢、運動新秀卡、海賊王及遊戲王等，並設現場開箱及抽獎活動。今屆首次引入官方現場卡牌評級服務。
一般入場時間為下午1時至8時，限量VIP門票可於中午12時入場。展覽在亞洲國際博覽館AsiaWorld-Summit（2號展館）舉行，可乘港鐵至亞洲國際博覽館站。主辦單位建議預先購票，因入場名額需求殷切。
